profile.headline: Sr Staff software Engineer | Building and Scaling Gen AI Applications | AI platform security
profile.summary:
Experience in leading large scale distributed applications based on Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), RESTful web services, Message bus architecture, object oriented design, Cloud based deployments.

Skilled in Java, Agile methodologies, Distributed Caching, Dockerization, Kubernetes, Auth protocols.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Software Development

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading Provider Simulation Platform. Creating distributed systems to give developers platform to simulate Financial Institutions.

Led projects to aggregate tax data from FIs. Built scalable, high quality services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of Intuit Private Cloud and Hosting Engineering team. Lead the project which does template based Provisioning for Linux/Windows, Environments(Linux/Windows) provisioning securely(Authentication and Authorization), C2V(Catalog to Virtual) Automation and automating Post-Provisioning activities. 

Worked on providing a streamlined and standardized API Engine to access back-end modules/applications. Also working on Implementing User Defined Recipes which client can define, persist and execute on the Virtual Machines remotely.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Primarily in Core Java/XML parsing/MySQL/Perl/Servlets/Spring MVC.
work area includes Active Test Network Monitoring, KPI Characterization, GSM/GPRS stuff and IAS protocols.
